td_projection.note: His chance is halfway between his triple-double rate over his last 80 games and 50%. We tested fancier versions (the PRA model's rebound and assist projections, recent-form blends) on the last two seasons and none predicted his nightly triple-doubles better than a coin flip, so his long-run rate pulled toward 50/50 is the honest number. No Yes price today, so the call is just whether his chance is above 50%.
